info.title: Marketapp API
info.description:
## Plans

- **Free** — See "Free" tag below for the list of free endpoints.
- **Paid** — All endpoints. Choose a plan on [Marketapp](https://marketapp.org/api-token).

Tokens issued before 23 August 2026 keep their current access until billing is enabled for them.

If you need any paid endpoints when using /rent, please contact support.

## Authentication

Endpoints require authentication via API token.

**How to authenticate:**
0. Get your API token from the [Marketapp](https://marketapp.org/api-token)
1. Add `Authorization` header to your request
2. Set the header value to your API token (without any prefix like "Bearer")

**Example:**
```
Authorization: your_api_token_here
```

## Code Examples

Some endpoints will return a transaction that you need to send to the blockchain yourself.
See [this example](https://github.com/crazyministr/marketapp-api-usage/blob/master/send_tx.py) to learn how to do this.

## News

Follow the [Marketapp API](https://t.me/marketapp_api) channel for the latest news and updates.

Buy a new VPN subscription or extend an existing one.

Omit `user_id` to create a new subscription. Pass `user_id` from a previous
completed order to extend that same subscription.

Returns a transaction you must send to the blockchain yourself, plus `invoice_id`.
Poll `GET /v1/vpn/{invoice_id}/` until `status` is `completed`, then give
`subscription_url` to your user (Happ / v2RayTun / Hiddify).

**Important**: If you are using USDT, you *must* send the transaction
from the same wallet that was used to generate your API token.
If not, then change `address` value from the response to the jetton wallet address of your wallet.

tags.name: vpn
tags.description:
**Free.**

Sell VPN to your users. You pay from the API-token wallet; each of your users gets their own subscription.

1. `GET /v1/vpn/tariffs/` — pick a tariff (`GRAM` or `USDT`).
2. `POST /v1/vpn/buy/` — omit `user_id` for a new subscription, or pass a previous `user_id` to extend it. Response: unsigned `transaction` + `invoice_id`.
3. Send the transaction yourself. For USDT, send from the API-token wallet.
4. Poll `GET /v1/vpn/{invoice_id}/` until `status` is `completed`. Recommended to poll every 5 seconds.
5. Give `subscription_url` to your user (Happ / v2RayTun / Hiddify). Save `user_id` to extend later or to fetch the link again via `GET /v1/vpn/user/{user_id}/`.
